roads.name: Scenic Route
words: Properly twisty: 21 curves in 2.5 miles, about 8 a mile.
From 241 to 267 ft, with 157 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 1.31 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.

roads.name: Lakeshore Drive
words: Properly twisty: 13 curves in 2.4 miles, about 5 a mile.
Plenty of tight curves among them.
From 237 to 266 ft, with 163 ft of up and down along the way.
Homes line much of it: about 51 buildings a mile beside the road.
